python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
xl = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')
print('Sheets:', xl.sheet_names)
for s in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(xl, sheet_name=s, header=None)
    print(f'--- Sheet: {s} ({df.shape[0]} rows x {df.shape[1]} cols) ---')
    print(df.to_string())
"

python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', header=None)
exp = df.iloc[10:22, [1, 2]].dropna(subset=[2])
exp.columns = ['Item', 'Amount']
exp['Category'] = df.iloc[10:22, 0].values
print(exp.to_string(index=False))
print()
print('Total Expenses: \$%.2f' % exp['Amount'].sum())
print()
print(exp.groupby('Category')['Amount'].sum().to_string())
"
